fields.onSuccess: I was right. As a result ...
fields.Conclusion_en: The dreams belong to an entity, we are only experiencing what they are dreaming about - wandering the halls, unable to get out, the séance being as far as they can get. I believe this entity spoke to me, through Miss Deane. It wants us to gather at the séance and help free it. That is as good a reason as I need to try and stop people from attending.

fields.ShortConclusion_en: We are experiencing the dreams of some entity, and those dreams seem to bleed into our reality upon waking.

fields.onSuccess: I was right. This Grand Séance was a scheme to draw Miss Deane to the manor - one she fell for. Perhaps I can use this knowledge to my advantage now...
fields.Conclusion_en: Miss Deane believed that she was descended from a powerful Milesian bloodline. She attended because someone invited her here, promising more information about her lineage.

fields.onSuccess: I was right. As a result ...
fields.Conclusion_en: Domhnall Ó Finn was kidnapped. He recognised the culprit's real identity and the culprit panicked. In the vision I received, it seemed the culprit encountered the bean nigh, who tried to feed off their grieving energy, but left as there was none to be found.
fields.Summary_en: Somebody was kidnapped at the ball, but who and why?
fields.ShortConclusion_en: Domhnall Ó Finn was kidnapped. He was the culprit's next victim but their hand was forced to take him earlier than intended.
fields.ShortQuestion_en: Who was kidnapped during the ball?

fields.onSuccess: I was right. As a result ...
fields.Conclusion_en: I have learned that Missus Joyce hired me. The staff do not seem to be responsible for Miss Deane's disappearance, but there is some unknown force compelling them to act in strange ways.
fields.Summary_en: There are now two confirmed missing people and proof of secret tunnels underground. What other secrets are hiding underneath the manor?
fields.ShortConclusion_en: I have learned that Missus Joyce hired me and that the staff are not involved in Miss Deane's disappearance.
fields.ShortQuestion_en: What secrets are hiding in the basement?

fields.onFail: I was incorrect. I don't know what's happening here, but maybe I'll find my answers at the Grand Séance.
fields.onSuccess: I was right. There are some very strange and sinister happenings at work in the Blake Manor, and they seem set to culminate in the Grand Séance. I need to stop it.
fields.Conclusion_en: Something or someone has driven the Marquess Blake mad. Perhaps the same magic that has convinced him and the staff that Walter Blake is real? As best I can tell there is a ritual that requires the blood of Blake, Deane, and Ó Finn to work and the Walter spectre exists to act as a proxy in Blake's mind as he spills his own blood!
fields.Summary_en: I now suspect something very strange is happening in the Blake private residence. What exactly is going on in there?
fields.ShortConclusion_en: Walter Blake is not real - a skilled painter has been adding him to paintings.
fields.ShortQuestion_en: What is going on in the Blake Residence?

fields.onSuccess: I need to find a way to stop the ritual before it's too late!
fields.confrontDescription: I confronted the Marquess and convinced him to see reality. In a fit of rage, he attacked Mister Coventry - or rather, Henry Blake - and both died in the process.
fields.Conclusion_en: The ritual has been stopped albeit not with the loss of some life...
fields.Summary_en: The séance is the beginning of a larger ritual that endangers everyone - can I get out there and stop it before it is too late?
fields.ShortConclusion_en: I have stopped the ritual!

fields.Summary_en: I should find out which bedroom was Miss Deane's. Perhaps it may hold some clues?
fields.ShortConclusion_en: I learned magic was used to lure her from her room and now have a trail to follow.

fields.onSuccess: Miss Quinn is looking to perform a ritual that will break the curse on her family, but she is in need of something that belonged to the woman - Eve O’Connor - who first laid the curse. She has asked that I try help her find such a thing.
fields.OutcomeChanged: Miss Quinn has removed the generational curse on her family by returning their lands and wealth to those they wronged.
fields.SavedNPC: Miss Quinn will no longer be attending the séance.
fields.confrontDescription: I need to find Miss Quinn and confront them about my hypothesis!
fields.Conclusion_en: I found the required item with Miss Barbosa, the last survivor of Eve O'Connor. Miss Quinn was able to summon the spirit and bestowed her family’s ill-gotten wealth to Miss Barbosa in way of reparation. The Quinn curse is now broken, and the remaining Quinn siblings allowed to live in peace. Having had enough of spectres, Miss Quinn is no longer attending the séance.

fields.onSuccess: The hotel is facing closure due to lack of funds. News of Miss Deane’s disappearance would sink it, taking the staff’s home and livelihoods with it. He has heard rumour of a stash of valuables hidden in the manor that would be enough to pay off the debts and he has given me a key in the hopes I can help him save the manor and their home.

fields.ShortQuestion_en: Why is Missus D'Arcy here?

fields.onSuccess: Mister Dupré found that his friend's soul had become trapped at the manor. In order to free her, he is standing as a representative for Maman Brigitte, but believes he needs two others to channel all her forms. As Laura manifested to me, I am to represent the goddess Bríd - but we need somebody to represent Saint Brigid.
fields.OutcomeChanged: With help from myself and Missus Joyce, his friend's soul is now freed from the manor's grip.
fields.SavedNPC: Mister Dupré is now protected from harm at the séance by Laura's spirit.
fields.confrontDescription: I need to find Mister Dupré and confront him about my hypothesis!
fields.Conclusion_en: Missus Joyce held space for Saint Brigid while I held it for the goddess, Bríd. With our help, Mister Dupré could summon the energies of Maman Brigitte and free his friend's soul. As a final act, her spirit has placed protections on both Mister Dupré and Missus Joyce for the séance.
fields.Summary_en: What business brought him all the way from America?
fields.ShortConclusion_en: He came to Ireland to release his friend's ashes but was drawn to the séance instead. He was nearly driven, by some force of magic, to transfer her soul into Evelyn Deane's body. We broke its hold.
fields.ShortQuestion_en: Why is Mister Dupré here?

fields.onSuccess: Mister Skerritt is ready to throw what is left of his life away in a foolish chance for posthumous fame, by being the ghost to speak at the séance. I wish to find him a better way to build a legacy, one less fatal to him and more useful to the world at large.
fields.OutcomeChanged: Mister Skerritt has decided upon a healthier way of building his legacy.
fields.SavedNPC: Mister Skerritt will no longer be attending the séance.
fields.confrontDescription: I need to find Mister Skerritt and confront him about my hypothesis!
fields.Conclusion_en: I have convinced Mister Skerritt that he could instead build a legacy for himself by donating his remaining time and money to charitable deeds. As such he is no longer going to attend the séance or give his life to it.
fields.Summary_en: What does he mean, we will all remember his name? What has he planned?
fields.ShortConclusion_en: He planned to kill himself during the séance to become the first ghost to speak across the viel. He now intends to build a legacy by philanthropic means so he will no longer attend the séance.
fields.ShortQuestion_en: How did Mister Skerritt think he would be remembered?

fields.onSuccess: Missus Joyce felt it was her God-given duty to stone Miss Mantovani to death. But she did not want to do this. I have convinced her to be more open-minded about the others' beliefs and she is willing to try and experience something suitable.
fields.OutcomeChanged: Missus Joyce has repented for her fearful ways and has opened her heart to other beliefs.
fields.SavedNPC: Missus Joyce is now protected from harm at the séance by Laura's spirit.
fields.confrontDescription: I need to find Missus Joyce and confront her about my hypothesis!
fields.Conclusion_en: Missus Joyce helped me free the spirit of Mister Dupre's friend. In doing so she has leaned not all different belief systems are bad. The freed spirit intends to protect them from any harm at the séance, by way of thanks.
fields.Summary_en: She does not seem to approve of the séance. Did she let slip an intention to sabotage it?
fields.ShortConclusion_en: She felt duty-bound to murder the séance's host. As penance, she helped free Mister Dupré's friend - who will protect them both at the séance.
fields.ShortQuestion_en: Was Missus Joyce planning to sabotage the séance?

fields.onSuccess: Miss Hisham is under the hold of the Vase of Nectanebo, a curse object that traps souls inside it. She has asked me to find the vase and destroy it.
fields.OutcomeChanged: Miss Hisham has been freed from the curse of her vase.
fields.SavedNPC: Miss Hisham will no longer be attending the séance.
fields.confrontDescription: I need to find Miss Hisham and confront her about my hypothesis!
fields.Conclusion_en: I found the vase and was able to destroy it before Miss Hisham could open it. When I smashed it the spirit of Wilhelmina Blake escaped - hopefully she is now at peace - and Miss Hisham was released from the vase's grip. She has decided to skip the séance as she recovers from the hold the vase had over her.
fields.Summary_en: What did she come to the west of Ireland to dig up?
fields.ShortConclusion_en: She was under the hold of the Vase of Nectanebo and came to open it. Now freed from its grasp, she will not attend the séance.
fields.ShortQuestion_en: What brought Miss Hisham to the manor?

fields.onSuccess: The cards have foretold Miss Mantovani's death, so she undertook to perform this séance as it pays well enough to provide for her family after she is gone. It seems her illness has deteriorated since coming here so she has asked me to ensure the funds get to her family.
fields.OutcomeChanged: Miss Mantovani has asked me to ensure her family gets her money so her death is not in vain.
fields.SavedNPC: Miss Mantovani will conduct the séance even though she believes she will die as a result.
fields.confrontDescription: I need to find Miss Mantovani and confront her about my hypothesis!
fields.Conclusion_en: I have collected Miss Mantovani's funds and will ensure they get to her family.
fields.Summary_en: It's a long way to come for work, why did she take the job?
fields.ShortConclusion_en: This event paid enough to allow her to provide for her family after her foretold death.
fields.ShortQuestion_en: What did Miss Mantovani undertake this séance?

fields.onSuccess: Mister O'Meara has told me he is attempting to speak with an angel, and has requested my help with a ritual to do so.
fields.OutcomeChanged: Mister O'Meara has met his angel and pledged his life to it.
fields.SavedNPC: Mister O'Meara will be protected by his angel during the séance.
fields.confrontDescription: I need to find Mister O'Meara and confront him about my hypothesis!
fields.Conclusion_en: I helped Mister O'Meara with his ritual, and he saw his angel. He will no longer have to go to dangerous lengths to do so as he pledged himself to the creature. In return he believes it will protect him from any dangers at the séance.
fields.Summary_en: What else is he hoping to contact while here?
fields.ShortConclusion_en: He was trying to contact and trap an angelic being but, having looked upon it, cannot bring himself to do so. He has pleged himself to it and it will protect him during the séance.
fields.ShortQuestion_en: What was Mister O'Meara hoping to contact while here?

fields.onSuccess: Miss Murphy is looking for news of her child who, born out of wedlock, was taken to a Magdalene laundry. but conventional means seem to have failed. Is there another way to help her?
fields.OutcomeChanged: Miss Murphy was able to use well scrying to see her child and will continue her studies in magic under Miss Callaghan.
fields.SavedNPC: Miss Murphy will no longer be attending the séance.
fields.confrontDescription: I need to find Miss Murphy and confront her about my hypothesis!
fields.Conclusion_en: I was able to arrange for Miss Callaghan to scry for Miss Murphy. This provided a glimpse of the little girl, alive and well. Miss Callaghan has promised to scry for her as often as Miss Murphy should want it. Feeling a wave of relief from seeing her child, Miss Murphy is going to rest while the séance is taking place, rather than attend it.
fields.Summary_en: What would be different if she knew magic?
fields.ShortConclusion_en: She believes magic would have given her power to keep her child. Having seen the girl is living a good life has allowed Miss Murphy let go of that trauma. She will not attend the séance.
fields.ShortQuestion_en: What would be different if Miss Murhpy knew magic?

fields.onSuccess: Mister Hunter bound Miss Deane in order to protect Miss McLeod. He has given me a key that he took from Miss Deane in the hopes it will help Miss McLeod overcome whatever harm Miss Deane has caused her.
fields.OutcomeChanged: Mister Hunter has done all he can to protect Miss McLeod from the whims of Miss Deane.
fields.SavedNPC: Mister Hunter will attend the séance but under the protection of a charm he made.
fields.confrontDescription: I need to find Mister Hunter and confront him about my hypothesis!
fields.Conclusion_en: Now that Miss McLeod is safe, Mister Hunter has lifted his binding on Miss Deane. He has also made protection charms for himself, Miss McLeod, and Missus Lau, so they will all be safe during the séance.
fields.Summary_en: Which woman is he worried could get hurt at the séance?
fields.ShortConclusion_en: He was concerned for Miss McLeod and relieved now that she is safe. He has made charms to protect her, Missus Lau, and himself during the séance.
fields.ShortQuestion_en: Which woman was Mister Hunter worried about?

fields.onSuccess: It seems Mister Ó Finn is of an ancient bloodline, as was Miss Deane... Is that why they've not both gone missing? Is there to be a third victim?
fields.OutcomeChanged: Mister Ó Finn is of the same bloodline as Miss Deane - this is why he, too, has been taken.
fields.SavedNPC: I do not yet know his final fate.
fields.Conclusion_en: It seems Mister Ó Finn is of an ancient bloodline, as is Miss Deane... Is that why they've both gone missing? Is there to be a third victim?
fields.Summary_en: He's deadset against the séance. Why is that?
fields.ShortConclusion_en: It seems he was, on some level, aware of his bloodline's duty to protect this place - is that why he was kidnapped?
fields.ShortQuestion_en: Why is Mister Ó Finn so against the séance?

fields.onSuccess: Mister Toussaint has given me Missus Erickson's room key and asked me to aid in his investigation of her fraud.
fields.OutcomeChanged: Mister Toussaint now has the information he needed on Missus Erickson, which will also ensure she does not do something more terrible.
fields.SavedNPC: Mister Toussaint is no longer attending the séance.
fields.confrontDescription: I need to find Mister Toussaint and confront him about my hypothesis!
fields.Conclusion_en: I provided Mister Toussaint with the information he needed on Missus Erickson and more, so he has what he needs to both debunk her but ensure she does not do something more terrible. With that in hand, he will no longer be attending the séance.
fields.Summary_en: Why is Mister Toussaint here and does it tie in with Miss Deane's disappearance?
fields.ShortConclusion_en: To prove that Missus Erickson is a fraud. He is using his knowledge of who I am to force me to aid in his investigation.
fields.ShortQuestion_en: Why is Mister Toussaint here?

fields.onSuccess: Father Sinnott believes there is an entity trapped here at the manor, an Aeon, that can be freed to save humanity. He has shown me the sigil that he believes can free it - by killing its physical form. He has asked me to aid him in this task as he is no longer psychically able to continue his search or attend the séance.
fields.OutcomeChanged: Father Sinnott has passed the Aeon-killing sigil, and all that it represents, on to me.
fields.SavedNPC: Father Sinnott will no longer be attending the séance.
fields.confrontDescription: I need to find Father Sinnott and confront him about my hypothesis!
fields.Conclusion_en: Father Sinnott has been carrying the weight of his mission too long. Without Seamus to help him, he's passed it on to me - along with a sigil that's capable of slaying an Aeon.
fields.Summary_en: He is interested the manor's secrets - what is he searching for?
fields.ShortConclusion_en: He came to kill an entity, freeing it from its prison and saving humanity. He has passed the means to free it to me and will no longer attend the séance.
fields.ShortQuestion_en: What was Father Sinnott searching for?

fields.onSuccess: Fiadh believes the well here is of great importance to the land and that the séance could cause severe damage to the area. She is trying to ward the well but cannot seem to do it alone - perhaps I can help find someone to help her?
fields.OutcomeChanged: She has healed the land with the help of her nephew.
fields.SavedNPC: Miss Callaghan will be protected at the séance.
fields.confrontDescription: I need to find Miss Callaghan and confront them about my hypothesis!
fields.Conclusion_en: Fiadh and Doctor Callaghan protected the well together. The land has protected them from harm by way of reward.
fields.Summary_en: What damage does she think the séance will do and what does she intend to do to minimise it?
fields.ShortConclusion_en: The well on the land is sacred and that the event of the séance could poison it. She has now protected the well, and the land has protected her in turn.
fields.ShortQuestion_en: What damage was Fiadh Callaghan worried about?

fields.onSuccess: Missus Erickson plans to eat the heart of a practitioner so she may steal their abilities! I need to stop her!
fields.OutcomeChanged: Using Mister Toussaint as a safeguard, I have talked Missus Erickson down.
fields.SavedNPC: Missus Erickson is no longer attending the séance.
fields.confrontDescription: I need to find Missus Erickson and confront her about my hypothesis!
fields.Conclusion_en: Thankfully, with Mister Toussaint's aid, I was able to talk her out of the heinous act of murder - and in doing so I found this séance is more sinister than it first seemed. Convinced of the folly of her plan, she is no longer to attend the séance.
fields.Summary_en: Why is Missus Erickson here and does it tie in with Miss Deane's disappearance?
fields.ShortConclusion_en: To eat the heart of Evelyn Deane to steal her magical abilities. I need to stop her!
fields.ShortQuestion_en: Why is Missus Erickson here?

fields.onSuccess: Miss Barbosa had come looking for information on her father in the hopes of seeing him through the séance - perhaps there is some way I can help?
fields.OutcomeChanged: With her father's name, picture, and ownership of his old land, Miss Barbosa's new start is ready to begin.
fields.SavedNPC: Miss Barbosa will no longer be attending the séance.
fields.confrontDescription: I need to find Miss Barbosa and confront her about my hypothesis!
fields.Conclusion_en: Doctor Callaghan was able to capture an image of Miss Barbosa and her father’s ghost together, providing her with the image of her father she so dearly wanted. With it, she no longer needs to attend the séance.
fields.Summary_en: What information is she looking for?
fields.ShortConclusion_en: She wanted to learn her father's name so she might learn more of her Irish ancestry. She has now gained an image of him so she is no longer attending the séance.
fields.ShortQuestion_en: What information was Miss Barbosa looking for?

fields.onSuccess: Miss McLeod is being blackmailed by Miss Deane over her relationship with Missus Lau. She has asked me to find the blackmail materials so she may destroy them and freely be with Missus Lau.
fields.OutcomeChanged: Having dispensed of the blackmail material gathered by Miss Deane, she is now free to live in peace with Missus Lau.
fields.SavedNPC: Miss McLeod will attend the séance, but under the protection of Mister Hunter's ward.
fields.confrontDescription: I need to find Miss McLeod and confront her about my hypothesis!
fields.Conclusion_en: I was able to retrieve the blackmail material hidden by Miss Deane. As a result Miss McLeod and Missus Lau are now free to be with one another. Mister Hunter has crafted charms for them that should protect them at the séance.
fields.Summary_en: Why is her second sight no longer working since coming to the manor?
fields.ShortConclusion_en: She was being drugged by Missus Lau, to cover up her attempts at retrieving material being used to blackmail them. Mister Hunter has made charms to protect them from further harm.
fields.ShortQuestion_en: Why is Miss McLeod's second sight not working at the manor?

fields.onSuccess: I was right. As a result ...
fields.OutcomeChanged: Marquess Blake was determined to resurrect his wife at any cost but he had been tricked into nearly sacrificing himself by the ousted heir Henry Blake posing as Simon Coventry.
fields.SavedNPC: The Marquess could not be saved.
fields.confrontDescription: I managed to convince the Marquess of Mister Coventry's manipulations. Grieving and enraged, he charged Mister Coventry.
fields.Conclusion_en: Henry Blake had convinced the Marquess that the ritual would resurrect his family. I revealed his deception, and the Marquess lunged for his throat. Both died in the scuffle - and the Blake lineage along with them.
fields.Summary_en: Why has he gone through such lengths and costs to host an event like this in the west of Ireland?

fields.onSuccess: Missus Lau has handed over a map of the catacombs she stole from Miss Deane. She asks I search for the blackmail material on her and Miss McLeod.
fields.OutcomeChanged: Having destroyed the blackmail materials, Missus Lau is now able to focus on her relationship with Miss McLeod.
fields.SavedNPC: Missus Lau will attend the séance, but she will be protected by Mister Hunter's ward.
fields.confrontDescription: I need to find Missus Lau and confront her about my hypothesis!
fields.Conclusion_en: I was able to retrieve the blackmail material hidden by Miss Deane. As a result Miss McLeod and Missus Lau are now free to resolve their troubles and move forward in their relationship. Mister Hunter has made them charms that should keep them safe during the séance.
fields.Summary_en: Why is she so eager to get away from here?
fields.ShortConclusion_en: Her attempts to stop Miss Deane's blackmailing of Miss McLeodwere spiralling out of hand and she wanted to get away. The materials are now destroyed and she is protected by Mister Hunter's charm.
fields.ShortQuestion_en: Why was Missus Lau so eager to get away from here?

fields.onSuccess: Doctor Callaghan is tired of living in Fiadh's shadow. He wants to prove his modern approach to magic is as valid as her older ways. I will keep an eye out for an opportunity in which he can prove this.
fields.OutcomeChanged: His aunt accepted his help, his ways, to protect the land.
fields.SavedNPC: Doctor Callaghan will be protected at the séance.
fields.confrontDescription: I need to find Doctor Callaghan and confront him about my hypothesis!
fields.Conclusion_en: Doctor Callaghan proved his modern ways were as valid as Fiadh's old ways by helping her protect the well. He has earned her respect as her peer as she seems willing to hand over the role when it is time. The well, the land, whatever it is, has protected them both for whatever the séance throws at them.
fields.Summary_en: He seems to have something to prove, but what and why?
fields.ShortConclusion_en: He wanted to prove his modern approach to magic is as valid as Fiadh's old ways. He did so by helping protect the well. The land has protect him from the séance as thanks.
fields.ShortQuestion_en: What did Doctor Callaghan want to prove?

fields.onSuccess: Mister Doyle had forgotten his past, it taken from him by the entity and its dreamings. My probing has unlocked the past for him and he has decided to step away from his original task. He will wait out the séance and leave once it is over to travel the world.
fields.OutcomeChanged: Mister Doyle has unburdened himself of his gnostic history and duty and will leave after the séance to travel the world.
fields.SavedNPC: Mister Doyle will no longer be attending the séance.
fields.confrontDescription: I need to find Mister Doyle and confront him about my hypothesis!
fields.Conclusion_en: Mister Doyle had forgotten his past, it taken from him by the entity and its dreamings. My probing has unlocked the past for him and he has decided to step away from his original task. He will wait out the séance and leave once it is over to travel the world.
fields.Summary_en: He seems unhappy to be here - then why stay?
fields.ShortConclusion_en: He came to help Father Sinnott with his quest, but lost those memories to the manor's effect. Now that he remembers, he is leaving that life behind and will not attend the séance.
fields.ShortQuestion_en: What has kept Mister Doyle at the manor?

fields.onSuccess: I was right. As a result ...
fields.OutcomeChanged: I understand now that Mister Coventry is actually an heir to the Blake Estate, Henry Blake.
fields.SavedNPC: Who is Mister Coventry?
fields.Conclusion_en: Mister Coventry has secretly been orchestrating the Grand Séance in order to reclaim his youth and title as the ousted heir of Blake Manor.
fields.Summary_en: Why is Mister Coventry here and does it tie in with Miss Deane's disappearance?
fields.ShortConclusion_en: Mister Coventry's goal is to take control of the Blake lineage.
fields.ShortQuestion_en: Why is Mister Coventry here and does it tie in with Miss Deane's disappearance?

fields.onSuccess: I was right. As a result ...
fields.confrontDescription: I need to find Campbell and confront them about my hypothesis!

fields.onSuccess: I was right. As a result ...
fields.OutcomeChanged: Walter Blake is not a real boy, but some form of mass hallucination that the Marquess and the staff are experiencing.
fields.SavedNPC: Walter Blake cannot be saved.
fields.Conclusion_en: Walter Blake is not real. He's a construction, both magically and emotionally, used to manipulate the events here at Blake Manor. But why and by who?
fields.Summary_en: After losing his mother so young, how does he feel about a séance on the grounds?

fields.onSuccess: The signature on Miss Deane's letter does not match that of the one used to sign in. Given that in the book would have been witnessed by the manager, I can only conclude that the one on the letter is fake. As such I think my employer is right, something sinister is afoot. My next course of action is to check her room for possible leads.
fields.Conclusion_en: The signature on Miss Deane's letter does not match that of the one used to sign in. Given that in the book would have been witnessed by the manager, I can only conclude that the one on the letter is fake. My employer is right, something sinister is afoot.
fields.Summary_en: I have arrived at the manor to confirm if Miss Deane was here and, if no longer present, was the manner of her leaving cause for concern?
fields.ShortConclusion_en: She did not leave the manor, though somebody wants people to think that she did.
fields.ShortQuestion_en: Is Miss Deane still at the manor?
